sources.title: Devising and Detecting Phishing Emails Using Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Abstract [en] This doctoral thesis addresses the rapidly evolving landscape of computer security threats posed by advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs). We demonstrate how AI can automate and enhance cyberattacks to identify the most pressing dangers and present feasible mitigation strategies.
